The localized pressure drop at P-R while upstream remained stable (n-18ljag6) indicates a failure within this specific distribution segment or downstream valve, rather than an upstream source loss.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1", "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-crpgvl"],
      "counterfactual": "If the failure were upstream of P-U, both P-U and P-R would have dropped simultaneously.",
      "competingExplanation": "A simultaneous drop at other points (North gallery) is not established by evidence; sampling limitations prevent ruling out a wider event affecting only RHOB's local indication or specific downstream path.",
      "evidenceGap": "Lack of continuous waveform data and valve state records for the entire distribution segment between P-U and P-R."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "toKey": "n-1oedffs",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The localized nature of the pressure drop (downstream issue) created a scenario where standard communication protocols might be insufficient if specific valve states or routing changes were not documented, potentially leading to confusion about why only RHOB was affected.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the issue were upstream, standard communication would likely have addressed a broader outage.",
      "competingExplanation": "The pressure drop itself is an equipment event; whether it *caused* a specific communication breakdown depends on unrecorded procedural expectations or environmental factors (noise/distance) not documented in evidence.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record of expected response times, specific valve states during the event, or documentation of any attempted communications between RHOB and Utilities regarding this localized failure."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1oedffs",
      "toKey": "n-1x7dd07",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The lack of documented communication medium and environmental conditions (noise, distance) means we cannot determine if these factors contributed to any potential delay or misunderstanding during the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["story-release:323756f5-dbe1-4650-9121-d583b3f97d77:bq-1fanm2w"],
      "claimIds": ["claim-1fnu5wq", "claim-7ubusy"],
      "counterfactual": "If the medium or environment were documented and suboptimal, it could explain delays; their absence leaves this as an unknown factor.",
      "competingExplanation": "The event occurred regardless of communication clarity. The *impact* on response time is what's in question, not just the existence of a potential breakdown.",
      "evidenceGap": "Absence of records detailing specific environmental conditions or communication logs for the 10:00-10:07 window."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-opw2ln",
      "toKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The existence of the distribution system (condition) enabled the localized failure to manifest as a pressure drop at P-R.",

      "claimIds": [],

      "competingExplanation": "None; a physical path is required for pressure to drop at a downstream point while upstream remains stable.",
      "evidenceGap": "N/A - Physical existence of the gallery and headers is established by directory."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-18ljag6",

      "claimIds": [],

      "competingExplanation": "The localized nature is a fact; whether it *enabled* a specific type of communication challenge depends on unrecorded procedural context.",
      "evidenceGap": "Lack of records showing expected procedures for handling localized vs. upstream failures."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1oedffs",

      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If these factors were documented and optimal, their contribution would be negligible.",
      "competingExplanation": "The event occurred; the *contribution* of unclear communication is an inference requiring evidence of expected response times or specific messages sent/received.",
      "evidenceGap": "No records of attempted communications or environmental conditions during the critical window."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The investigation identifies a localized instrument-air pressure drop at RHOB (P-R) while upstream remained stable, indicating an issue within the distribution path downstream of P-U. The exact cause (valve failure, routing change, etc.) is unknown due to lack of valve state and continuous data records. Communication breakdowns are unsupported by evidence but remain a hypothesis given unrecorded medium/environmental factors.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1", "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Exact location of failure within distribution path (valve vs. leak)", "Whether simultaneous event occurred elsewhere", "Specific communication attempts and their success/failure", "Environmental conditions affecting message clarity"],
    "alternatives": ["Upstream source failure with isolated RHOB indication error (contradicted by P-U stability)", "Widespread outage masked at other points due to sampling limitations (possible but unsupported)"],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },
  "evidenceRequests": [
    "Request continuous pressure waveform data for the entire distribution segment between P-U and P-R.",
    "Request valve state logs or manual records for all valves in the RHOB instrument-air path during the event window (10:00-10:15).",
    "Request communication logs (radio, phone) showing messages sent/received by Utilities and RHOB between 10:00 and 10:20.",
    "Request documentation of expected response times for instrument-air low-pressure alarms at this location."
  ]
}
